title: Field size bound in terms of dimension and bias
statement: Let $n$, $a$, and $b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$. Set $\varepsilon=a/b$, let $S=\lceil nb/a\rceil$, and let $D=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 S\rceil)$. Then $2^D\le 4n/\varepsilon$.
